retained_survivor_findings.name: public-missing-user-edge
retained_survivor_findings.scope: existing selected public class native target; static predicted proof gap, no production defect claim
retained_survivor_findings.reason: Missing native observation in the test; production implementation already contains the correct edge/shape.
retained_survivor_findings.why_old_assertions_missed_it: The old native target invoked subscribePublicTopics with empty topics and invoked subscribeUserTopics separately after populating them; deleting the connecting call changed no observed native result.
retained_survivor_findings.discriminating_native_observation: The strengthened native target populates topics first, invokes the actual installed fixed arrow and requires exactly three original native subscription arguments before wire assertions.

retained_survivor_findings.name: public-missing-dispose-edge
retained_survivor_findings.scope: existing selected public class native target; static predicted proof gap, no production defect claim
retained_survivor_findings.reason: Missing native observation in the test; production implementation already contains the correct edge/shape.
retained_survivor_findings.why_old_assertions_missed_it: The old native target inspected the dispose descriptor but never called it. The separate actual-source witness could not detect deletion of the Rust lifecycle delegation.
retained_survivor_findings.discriminating_native_observation: The strengthened target invokes the actual native prototype method with a foreign receiver, requires stopPingLoop then super.dispose and verifies both original receiver handles.

resolution.named_assertion: PUBLIC installed dispose reaches stop then super

retained_survivor_findings.name: public-interval-own-undefined
retained_survivor_findings.scope: existing selected public class native target; static predicted proof gap, no production defect claim
retained_survivor_findings.reason: Missing native observation in the test; production implementation already contains the correct edge/shape.
retained_survivor_findings.why_old_assertions_missed_it: The old native assertion used get(interval)==undefined, which accepted both an absent property and an own property whose value was undefined; JSON serialization also omits that own property.
retained_survivor_findings.discriminating_native_observation: The strengthened target checks exact ordered native own keys and enumerability before value/wire assertions, so depth/BBO must have only type and coin.
